# Every TM

[Back to the guide](../players-guide.md#where-to-find-every-tm)

A TM, once owned, teaches any of your Pokemon that can learn its move, as often as you like. Every TM below can come from three places: **the Poke Mart** (five a day, a different five each day, at the price shown), **a won wild battle** (5% of wins on easy, 8% on hard, always one you do not own), and **the Battle Zone counter** (five a day that the Mart is not selling, for BP). A few are also Game Corner prizes. You never get a TM you already own.

## The signature TMs

Ten moves are sold only at the Battle Zone counter, and each teaches only its own Pokemon. No opponent ever uses one.
